metadata.note: Admit only complete directed stop patterns on explicitly mapped operator/line geometry. All source calls, branches, call rules and border termini retained. Every pair must pass projection, connectivity and detour checks. Historic official corridor inference, not certified street directions, current diversions or observed movement. Three individually pinned sub-metre topology connectors are inferred and reported per pair and trip; no other gap filling. Failed bus pairs may use complete exact-identity Luzern 2026 paths; successful original pairs are retained and every source switch is recorded at a scheduled stop. Zugerbergbahn uses exact federal installation and operating-point identities, retaining its full curve and reporting GTFS endpoint connectors. Explicitly reviewed bus pairs may use OSM road inference only after the official paths fail, with whole-pattern identity and all-context path consensus. Failed S26/RE6 Däniken–Schönenwerd and IR75 Kreuzlingen–Konstanz pairs may use four exact standard-gauge SBB graphical segments, with full source curves and measured endpoint attachments. Federal source failures and the Däniken gauge conflict remain recorded. Two exact boat route/agency identities may use their explicitly inventoried swissTLMRegio lake graphs. GTFS dock attachment is capped at 200 m, with no new graph links. Every path segment is split at every Vector25 shoreline intersection; outside-water intervals must lie wholly within 200 m of one actual endpoint dock and are disclosed. Other land crossings reject the complete trip. These generalized cartographic paths are not navigational shipping lanes. Only the two reviewed line 619 Zentrum/Chloesterli pairs may use a separately pinned local OSM service-road run after the previous road matcher rejects them. Both the service-road run and an unchanged-configuration control retain all four route patterns; both are reimported offline. All previous successful geometry remains unchanged. The three reviewed N6 Huenenberg Dorf–Sins Bahnhof contexts may retain their own original successful matcher paths, keyed by complete ordered stop identity. Every containing context is reviewed; variants must share their approach and diverge only within 110 m of the destination. The failed shared-pair consensus remains recorded; this is not a reusable pair override. Only the two explicitly reviewed Zugersee direct pairs may fall back to original OSM ferry ways after a primary remote-land-crossing failure. Each is bound to its complete ordered GTFS pattern and OSM route relation; dock attachments are capped at 30 m and the original shoreline and detour rules still apply. The rejected primary path evidence is retained.
metadata.scope: Every annual GTFS trip with at least one source stop inside the complete official Zug polygon, across every agency and mode. Fixture trips retain every source call, including cross-canton termini. No straight-line crossing test for nonstopping through traffic.
exclusions: Annual membership is complete for the pinned national timetable and official canton polygon, not proof of unrepresented real-world services.
Friday/Sunday plus preceding-day carry-in do not establish seasonal, holiday or year-round coverage.
No-stop through traffic is outside this passenger-service inventory.

Geometry admission uses mapped Zug Buslinien, exact Luzern 2026 bus supplements, standard-gauge FOT infrastructure and the exact federal Zugerbergbahn installation. Unresolved boat/rail/bus patterns remain in the coverage denominator. Both lake services have explicitly attributed swissTLMRegio inference, with 2007 shoreline evidence and recorded dock-area discrepancies; remote land crossings remain excluded. Failed explicitly inventoried bus pairs may use separately attributed OSM road inference; these paths are not operator-verified. The separately attributed SBB graphical supplement covers two explicit rail corridors; foreign schematic records are excluded. The scoped line 619 service-road supplement retains raw local OSM, both control and amended matcher outputs and the exact single configuration change; it is still inferred routing. N6 has three explicitly reviewed full-pattern variants at Sins Bahnhof; the common-pair ambiguity remains in provenance and current diversion validity is unproven.
The WFS matches the archive within 1 mm but proves no 2026 alignment validity. No realtime.

policy.method: Exact operating-point number, standard gauge (mm1435) only, original declared topology. Every other scheduled operating point is blocked during each pair search. Paths are inferred infrastructure corridors; track assignment and 2026 validity remain unproven.

wfsComparison.comparison: Every t_id, exact comma-separated line label, ordered vertex count and each LV95 ordinate, with 1 mm tolerance for export precision. WFS feature IDs differ from GeoPackage IDs.
wfsComparison.vintageConclusion: Current WFS repeats the archive geometry within export precision. Neither a 2026 alignment date nor current diversions are established.
